definitions.explanation: the correct or standard form of a Chinese character, as opposed to simplified or variant forms

examples.english: The standard form of '芸' is '藝'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正字|せいじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Names must be entered in the family register using standard character forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略字|りゃくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{正字|せいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: In modern Japanese, simplified characters are widely used, but knowing the standard forms is useful when reading classical texts.

notes:
In the context of Japanese kanji, refers to the traditional, orthodox form of a character before simplification. After the 1946 {当用|とうよう}⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ reform, many characters were simplified for everyday use. The pre-reform forms are called {正字|せいじ} or ⟦{旧字体|きゅうじたい}→旧字体：27161_kyuujitai⟧. Relevant for reading pre-war texts, understanding name kanji in official documents, and studying classical literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正字|せいじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in standard character form
- {正字|せいじ}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧: standard character style
- {正字|せいじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{略字|りゃくじ}: standard and simplified characters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旧字体|きゅうじたい}→旧字体：27161_kyuujitai⟧: old character form — practically synonymous, used more commonly in modern discussions
- {略字|りゃくじ}: abbreviated/simplified character — the opposite: a shortened form
- ⟦{新字体|しんじたい}→新字体：27162_shinjitai⟧: new character form — the modern simplified forms adopted after the reform
- ⟦{異体字|いたいじ}→異体字：29209_itaiji⟧: variant character — any alternative form of a character, whether standard or not
